name: combat
description: Universal agent operating core: triage, system modeling, ranked hypotheses, evidence discipline, deep search, web extraction, verification, safety gates and stop policy.

interface.shortDescription: Decision core for agents: triage, hypotheses, evidence, verification, safety
interface.longDescription: COMBAT turns an agent from a fast answerer into a disciplined problem solver. It triages every task, builds a causal model of the system, ranks falsifiable hypotheses instead of guessing, separates facts from assumptions, runs multi-step research and structured web extraction, refuses to claim success without evidence, gates irreversible actions, and stops with an honest report.
